user.title: Connect to InfoMentor
user.description: Log in with BankID. No token needs to be copied.

menu_options.bankid: BankID – scan a QR code on another device

reauth.title: InfoMentor rejected the login
reauth.description: Authorise the integration again with BankID.

menu_options.bankid: BankID – scan a QR code on another device

bankid.title: Log in with BankID
bankid.description: Open [the QR code in a browser]({qr_url}). Scan it with BankID on another device, or press “Open BankID” on that page to approve on the same phone. The link works only while this dialog is open.

token.title: Connect with a refresh token
token.description: Paste an OAuth2 refresh token from the InfoMentor Hub mobile grant. Only needed when BankID cannot be used.

children.title: Choose children
children.description: Select which linked children should get entities in Home Assistant.

bankid_wait.title: Confirm in BankID
bankid_wait.description: Open [the login page]({qr_url}) and scan the code with BankID on your phone. The dialog continues by itself when you approve.

progress.bankid_scan: Waiting for your approval in BankID…

error.wrong_account: That login belongs to a different InfoMentor account.
error.bankid_timeout: The BankID login timed out. Try again.
error.bankid_cancelled: The BankID login was cancelled or rejected. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This InfoMentor account is already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not find the entry to reauthenticate.
abort.bankid_unavailable: Could not start the BankID login. Check the connection to InfoMentor and try again.
